'''Celebration VI''' was a ''[[Star Wars]]'' Celebration fan convention held at the [[Wikipedia:Orange County Convention Center|Orange County Convention Center]] in [[Wikipedia:Orlando, Florida|Orlando, Florida]] between [[August 23]] and [[August 26]], [[2012]]. The convention returned to Orlando due to the success of [[Celebration V]] in [[2010]]. Celebration VI was first revealed in late [[May]] [[2011]] when a teaser website was created prompting guests to sign up for updates. In early [[June]] 2011 the website was updated to reveal the date and venue of the event

''[[Star Wars: Transmission]]'', a then upcoming talk show, was announced on the first day of the fan convention. In addition, several T-shirts made by the women's clothing company Her Universe, founded by [[Ashley Eckstein]], who voiced [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] in ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars,'' were released as souvenirs for the event, including two exclusive tank tops, representing the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] respectively, along with a [[Mara Jade]]–style T-shirt., and a sterling-silver charm styled after [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. Each piece was limited to only 300 units, 50 of which were online exclusives.

Celebrity guests included [[Ben Burtt]], [[Jake Lloyd]], [[Ian McDiarmid]], [[Peter Mayhew]], [[Anthony Daniels]], [[Temuera Morrison]], and [[Mark Hamill]].

One event at the event included an "Archive Party" hosted by ''Star Wars'' merchandise fansite, Star Wars Collectors Archive. Some merchandise included joke invitations relating to manatees and other related aquatic mammals called "Manatee Man" (referencing the name of a character from ''A New Hope''), "The Sea Cows Strike Back" (with "4LOManatee," parodying the character [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]], although the design implied that it was actually supposed to be [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], in a reference to the vintage [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] toy line switching the two names), "Return of the Manati" (with "Manatee Face"), and a collector's coin depicting a manatee.

The audio drama ''[[Star Wars: Smuggler's Gambit]]'' was performed at Celebration VI.

Celebration VI store merchandise included a Piggy Bank modelled after a Gamorrean Guard; a talking plush [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Admiral Ackbar]] doll; a 2013 Calendar showing retro-style ''Star Wars'' artwork made by [[David Craig]]; a Whoopie Cushion styled after [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]; an Imperial corporate logo journal; a set of salt and pepper shakers modeled after a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Vader/Legends|Darth Vader]]; a basket set of four baby [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] dolls; limited-edition six-inch resin maquettes of [[Mara Jade]], [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], and a [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing Virus]]-infected stormtrooper; a Mos Eisley spaceport t-shirt; a [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]-style soft knit cap; a T-shirt based on previously unused sketch concept art for ''Return of the Jedi''; a [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] postage stamp art T-shirt; and a VaderAde T-shirt depicting Darth Vader's arm gripping a drink canister with a red fluid as well as the VaderAde container itself.

Some artwork released by [[Dave Dorman]] was also issued for Celebration VI. In addition, 600 square feet in the Exhibition Hall was dedicated to an exhibit of various ''Star Wars'' memorabilia hosted by [[Rancho Obi-Wan]], a non-profit museum that hosts the largest private collection of ''Star Wars'' memorabilia, including rare discarded items from development of the films and even some fan-made items.

Aside from ''Star Wars''–related events, there was a eulogy given by Mark Hamill regarding the Batman villain, the Joker, who Hamill had previously voiced.<ref>{{YouTube|video=n1aWoNvv7aU|text=Mark Hamill Joker Eulogy Celebration 6 CVI Star Wars|channel=channel/UCO3ss8kERX6S4gEOkzMg3XQ|name=Michael Sheffield|archivedate=20200317143822}}</ref>
